introText: At LYVI, your physical therapist's expertise combines with the Renata França method to offer you lymphatic drainage treatments with immediate results. In Lyon's 1ˢᵗ arrondissement or in the comfort of your own home, each session is a wellness break: a moment to lighten and reenergize your body.

myApproach.title: MY APPROACH
myApproach.p1: It is with warmth and professionalism that I welcome you to offer you the best Renata França treatments.
myApproach.p2: Whether for a single session or a course of treatment, I am committed to supporting you with care and efficiency towards your goals.
myApproach.p3: In a wellness cocoon at the Coream center, I offer lymphatic drainage, body sculpting, and Miracle Face, with visible results from the very first session:
myApproach.p4: At Lyvi, I have one goal: for you to leave feeling relaxed, light, and radiant.

treatments.title: TREATMENTS
treatments.p1: Renata França treatments are rhythmic manual massages using pressure and pumping movements that deliver visible results from the very first session. The technique stimulates blood circulation, reduces swelling, and promotes the elimination of toxins. The massages help refine the silhouette and reduce the appearance of cellulite, while strengthening the immune system.
